boundary: protocol-v1-shaped unregistered task-local adapter; mirrors adapters/controls request and result fields
invariants: No public ABI, header, descriptor, registry default, installed behaviour, CONTRACTS.md or CMakeLists.txt change is included.
All controls are explicit, numeric, finite and range checked; absent controls are rejected rather than defaulted.
Each reset-delimited segment receives one gain computed from that segment's complete finite input; no per-sample attack, release or lookahead exists.
Exact gain arithmetic is target_linear / max(input_rms, 1e-8), clamped to the configured linear gain bounds and expressed with 20*log10; output is f32(sample * gain) hard-clamped to +/- ceiling.
Whole segments at or below silence_floor_dbfs bypass amplification; quiet spans inside an active segment are not gated and pause amplification remains an explicit unresolved risk.
Nonfinite inputs are counted; finite-only RMS is used for planning and C++-style min/max ordering maps nonfinite products to the finite ceiling. This is an observation, not a robustness endorsement.
Session state is keyed by session_id and canonical control digest; continued sessions replay buffered samples, stale epochs reject before state changes and sessions do not leak.
Headroom is measured against the configured hard ceiling; clipped samples and nonfinite-mapped samples are counted explicitly.
No missing result qualifies a candidate; real-speech, listening, loudness-standard, native-provider and device/deadline qualifications remain incomplete.
Fixed v0 format is unchanged: 16 kHz mono f32, 160 samples per frame.
public_v0_abi: unchanged; proposal-only reference and deterministic synthetic fixture
